description: Get the live price in Philippine pesos for a Boracay airport transfer by package, trip type, airport and passengers. It is the same price the myboracayguide.com booking form shows, discounts included. Books nothing.

adults_with_ph_id.description: Adult (6 yrs and up) with a Philippine ID, local rate

adults_without_ph_id.description: Adult (6 yrs and up) without a Philippine ID, foreign rate

airport.description: Caticlan (MPH) is what almost everyone flies into; Kalibo (KLO) is about 2 hours by road. Defaults to Caticlan.

children_with_ph_id.description: Child (0 to 5 yrs) with a Philippine ID, travels free

children_without_ph_id.description: Child (0 to 5 yrs) without a Philippine ID, travels free

package.description: Package name from list_boracay_airport_transfers. Defaults to "Standard Transfer", which most travellers book.

seniors_with_ph_id.description: Senior (60 and up) with a Philippine senior or PWD ID, 20% off

seniors_without_ph_id.description: Senior (60 and up) without a Philippine ID, adult rate

trip_type.description: Arrival = airport to hotel, Departure = hotel to airport, Round Trip = both.

name: quote_boracay_airport_transfer
title: Price a Boracay airport transfer
